title: 第4章 可以偷袭！
content_zh:
轩辕一头扎入了距离树房不远处的小溪之中。

孤星则是在小溪的岸上守住轩辕的物品，一套换洗的麻布衣以及一瓶散发着一股清凉气息的疗伤药瓶，还有一把锈迹斑斑，黑不溜秋的匕首。

轩辕在小溪之中，将身上那沾满污垢的衣服给脱掉，顺着水流飘下去之后，仿佛游鱼般在水中游动了起来。

片刻之后，轩辕终于将身体洗得干净之后，整个人赤条条地上了岸，抓起了尹甄洛给自己的那一瓶疗伤药，打开瓶盖，一股清凉的气息直冲轩辕的脑门，让轩辕感觉到无比的舒畅，好像闻着这股气息就能够让自己伤势好了许多一样。

轩辕将疗伤药洒了一点在自己胸口上那狰狞的伤口之上，只见原本还渗着些许血迹的结痂伤口，逐渐开始缓缓脱落。

“天呐，这是什么药，竟然这么厉害！”

轩辕明白，孤身一人在这个世界上，像这种极品的疗伤药，绝对不能够浪费，一点一滴，有时候都是救命的关键！

所以轩辕非常节省的在几个比较大，开始凝固的伤口撒上了一点点之后，很麻利地穿起了换洗的布衣，如获至宝般的将这一瓶疗伤药给藏进了布衣内的暗格口袋，做完这一切之后，轩辕便朝树房奔去，心中狂呼。

轩辕毕竟上辈子也只是一个初中生而已，虽然说从小当乞丐，看尽了人情冷暖，世态炎凉，对人的第一眼，天生好坏就会有明确的感觉，乞丐是什么？乞丐就是每天都要向人乞讨，偶尔轩辕会跟一个破落算命的说几句话，所以也学得到了一些相面的本事，心德，对于尹甄洛基本上毫无戒心。

因为一方面，轩辕相信自己的感觉，另外一方面在轩辕看来，像尹甄洛这样的女人想要杀死自己，一根手指头足矣，但是对方竟然肯答应教自己修炼，这就是莫大的恩情了，他不敢去怀疑什么。

一片夕阳的余晖透过树窗洒进树房之中。

在树房中心的深坑之中，在一个烧烤架上，整串着一只烤乳猪，显然是轩辕的杰作，得到了这个身体前世的记忆，做起这些事情来，自然是轻车熟路，各种天然佐料洒下，让人忍不住流口水的肉香，飘荡在树房之内。

而在一旁的孤星早已经口水长流了，尹甄洛此刻盘膝坐在地上，饶有兴致地看着轩辕那一副专心致志的样子，缓缓道：

“看不出来，你的手艺蛮不错的。”

尹甄洛气结，她是什么身份，这些事情自然都不需要她来做了，冷哼了一声，尹甄洛直接不说话了。

轩辕笑了笑，也不在意，做完这一切之后，轩辕拿起手中那锈迹斑斑的匕首，削肉如泥般，将最嫩最好吃的部位给削在了木盘之中，端到尹甄洛面前，笑嘻嘻道：

尹甄洛看着轩辕嬉皮笑脸的样子，虽然轩辕的长相虽然不是那种多么俊美的类型，但是笑起来给人的感觉就是特别的干净，耐看。

“这还差不多。”尹甄洛虽然已经修炼到了一定的地步，但是也没有到达可以不吃不喝的程度，如今有美食在前，自然也不会抗拒。

在孝敬的尹甄洛的时候，轩辕的眼睛还是不由自主地往尹甄洛的锁骨下飘，心里砰砰砰地跳动着，轩辕深吸了一口气，赶紧收摄了一下自己的心神，立刻转移了目光，更加坚定自己内心的信念了。

“轩辕啊，轩辕，以后就要找一个像尹甄洛师父这样的媳妇才可以，所以一定要好好努力修炼了，不然连女人都打不过，就丢脸了。”

接过了轩辕手中的木盘，将注意力放在轩辕手中木盘美食中的尹甄洛，对于轩辕的眼神，浑然未觉，她自然也不知道轩辕心里在想着这些。

尹甄洛从自己的身上拿出了一把银色的小刀，切出一道细细的肉片，放进嘴里里，细细咀嚼了起来，感觉到无比美味。

只是当她看向了轩辕的时候，却发现轩辕与孤星正分吃着肉干，尹甄洛愣了一下，不解地问道：

“为什么你要吃那些肉干呢？吃刚刚出炉的肉不好么？”

“今天算是我给你拜师，这个当然要请美人师父吃顿好的，本来这只小野猪足够我跟孤星两天的，如果省着点吃，能够吃更久，因为魔兽森林时常有强大的魔兽出没，并不是每天都能够成功的打到猎物的，我跟孤星吃这些肉干也是一样的。”

说完，轩辕掰断手中那已经硬梆梆的肉干，与孤星分半，啃了起来，看到这一幕，尹甄洛突然感觉到有些苦涩，自己家庭环境优越，轩辕自然比不得自己了。

轩辕听到尹甄洛的话，啃食肉干的动作停顿了一下，眼神中闪过一丝落寞，不管是前世还是今生，自己都是无父无母的孤儿，顿了一会儿，轩辕这才道：

“我是孤儿，没有父母，只有孤星跟孤月，不过孤月在不久前，被月荒城的城主之子，月绝给害死了。”

尹甄洛看着轩辕眸子之中的落寞，没来由的心头一酸，微微地叹了叹，没有再说什么了。

轩辕一边啃着肉干，一边看着尹甄洛吃肉的动作，每一个举动，每一次咀嚼，都是慢条斯理，给人的感觉就是优雅，无可挑剔。

也不知道过了多久，天色已经暗了下来了，一片月华透过树窗洒在树房的中心，尹甄洛盘膝闭目，在月华的照耀下，仿佛广寒仙子般，遗世独立，不可方物，轩辕看得有些痴了。

一时之间，轩辕仿佛很享受这种安静的感觉，若是此刻能够永恒就好了，就这样静静地看着……

尹甄洛睁开美眸，看着痴痴地看着自己的轩辕，指了指身前的烤乳猪，道：

“你将它做成肉干吧，你吃什么，我就跟你吃什么，不需要特意去准备，从明天开始，修炼开始。”

尹甄洛又好气又好笑地白了轩辕一眼，站起身来，一步一步地走到了树床边，躺了下去，道：

“休息吧，我睡床上，你睡地上。”

轩辕擦了擦口水，忙不迭地点头道：

“应该的，没让我睡外面就已经很好了！”

“还有，既然你已经拜我为师了，那么我就先定一条规矩。”尹甄洛躺在木床之上，侧着身子，一对明亮的大眼睛，在月辉的映衬之下，温柔如水，让轩辕再度陶醉了。

“从今夜开始，你可以在任何的时间，任何的情况下来偷袭我，如果偷袭成功的话，你想干什么，都随便你。”

轩辕闻言，眸子之中，精芒爆闪，虎躯一震，口水长流，仿佛一头饿狼般，直接朝着尹甄洛猛扑了过去。

尹甄洛无言地叹息了一声，玉指轻弹，一缕劲风直接打在了轩辕的额头上，直接将轩辕打飞了出去，在地上连滚三四下，极为狼狈。

孤星并没有想之前那样，对着尹甄洛那般咆哮，发出威胁的声音，狼眼之中，似乎还透露着几丝幸灾乐祸的味道。

轩辕心有不甘，当夜，轩辕足足偷袭了尹甄洛十七次，每一次连尹甄洛的头发都没碰到，下场惨不忍睹。
content_en:
Xuanyuan plunged into the creek not far from the tree house.

Lone Star was guarding Xuanyuan's belongings on the bank of the stream, a change of linen clothes, a healing medicine bottle that exuded a cool breath, and a rusty, black dagger.

Xuanyuan was in the stream, taking off the dirt-stained clothes on his body, and after floating down the water, he started swimming in the water like a fish.

A moment later, after Xuanyuan finally washed his body clean, he landed naked on the shore, grabbed the bottle of healing medicine that Yin Zhenluo gave him, opened the bottle cap, and a cool breath rushed straight to Xuanyuan's forehead, making Xuanyuan feel extremely comfortable, as if smelling this breath could make his injuries much better.

Xuanyuan sprinkled a little healing medicine on the hideous wound on his chest, and saw that the scab that was still oozing with some blood gradually began to fall off.

"Oh my god, what kind of medicine is this? It's so powerful!"

Xuanyuan understands that when you are alone in this world, you must not waste the best healing medicine like this. Every little bit is sometimes the key to saving your life!

Therefore, Xuanyuan was very economical and sprinkled a little bit on a few relatively large wounds that were beginning to solidify. He quickly put on a change of cloth and hid the bottle of healing medicine in the hidden pocket of the cloth as if he had found a treasure. After doing all this, Xuanyuan ran towards the tree house, screaming in his heart.

After all, Xuanyuan was just a junior high school student in his last life. Although he had been a beggar since he was a child, he had seen all the warmth and coldness of people, and the harshness of the world. At the first sight of a person, he would have a clear feeling about whether he was born good or bad. What is a beggar?Beggars had to beg from people every day. Occasionally, Xuanyuan would talk to a shabby fortune teller, so he also learned some fortune-telling skills and moral integrity, and he was basically unwary of Yin Zhenluo.

Because on the one hand, Xuanyuan believed in his feelings, and on the other hand, in Xuanyuan's view, a woman like Yin Zhenluo wanted to kill him, and one finger was enough, but the other party actually agreed to teach him how to practice. This was a great kindness, and he did not dare to doubt anything.

The afterglow of the setting sun shines into the tree house through the tree window.

In the deep pit in the center of the tree house, on a barbecue grill, there is a roasted suckling pig, which is obviously the masterpiece of Xuanyuan. He has obtained the memory of this body's previous life. He is naturally familiar with doing these things. Various natural seasonings are sprinkled, and the aroma of meat that makes people drool is floating in the tree house.

Lone Star on the side was already drooling. Yin Zhenluo was sitting cross-legged on the ground, looking at Xuanyuan's concentrated expression with interest, and said slowly:

"I can't tell, but your craftsmanship is quite good."

Yin Zhenluo was furious. Who was she? Naturally, she didn't need to do these things. She snorted coldly, and Yin Zhenluo stopped talking.

Xuanyuan smiled and didn't care. After doing all this, Xuanyuan picked up the rusty dagger in his hand and sliced the meat like mud. He sliced the tenderest and most delicious parts on a wooden plate, brought it to Yin Zhenluo, and said with a smile:

Yin Zhenluo looked at Xuanyuan's playful smile. Although Xuanyuan's appearance was not that handsome, his smile gave people a particularly clean and attractive look.

"That's pretty much it." Although Yin Zhenluo has cultivated to a certain level, he has not yet reached the level where he can neither eat nor drink. Now that he has delicious food in front of him, he will naturally not resist.

When he was with the filial Yin Zhenluo, Xuanyuan's eyes still drifted involuntarily to Yin Zhenluo's collarbone, and his heart was beating loudly. Xuanyuan took a deep breath, quickly collected his mind, and immediately changed his gaze, strengthening his inner belief.

"Xuanyuan, Xuanyuan, from now on you have to find a wife like Master Yin Zhenluo, so you must practice hard, otherwise you will be embarrassed if you can't even beat a woman."

Yin Zhenluo, who took the wooden plate from Xuanyuan's hand and focused on the food on the wooden plate in Xuanyuan's hand, was completely unaware of Xuanyuan's eyes. Naturally, she didn't know what Xuanyuan was thinking about.

Yin Zhenluo took out a silver knife from his body, cut out a thin slice of meat, put it in his mouth, chewed it carefully, and felt it was extremely delicious.

But when she looked at Xuanyuan, she found that Xuanyuan and Lone Star were eating dried meat separately. Yin Zhenluo was stunned for a moment and asked in confusion:

"Why do you eat those dried meats? Isn't it good to eat freshly baked meat?"

"Today is my apprenticeship for you. Of course, I have to treat the beautiful master to a good meal. Originally, this little wild boar was enough for Lone Star and I for two days. If we save some food, we can eat it for longer, because powerful monsters often appear in the Warcraft Forest, and not every day we can successfully hunt prey. It is the same for Lone Star and I eating these dried meats."

After saying that, Xuanyuan broke off the hard dried meat in his hand, divided it in half with Lone Star, and started to nibble. Seeing this scene, Yin Zhenluo suddenly felt a little bitter. His family environment was superior, and Xuanyuan was naturally inferior to him.

When Xuanyuan heard Yin Zhenluo's words, he paused in the movement of eating dried meat, and a trace of loneliness flashed in his eyes. No matter in the past life or in this life, he was an orphan without a father and a mother. After a pause, Xuanyuan said:

"I am an orphan. I have no parents. I only have Lone Star and Lone Moon. However, Lone Moon was killed not long ago by Yue Jue, the son of the city lord of Yuehuang City."

Yin Zhenluo looked at the loneliness in Xuanyuan's eyes, and felt sad for no reason. She sighed slightly and said nothing more.

Xuanyuan gnawed on the dried meat while watching Yin Zhenluo's movements of eating the meat. Every move and every chew was done slowly, giving the impression of elegance and impeccability.

I don’t know how long it took, but the sky had darkened. A piece of moonlight shone through the tree window in the center of the tree house. Yin Zhenluo crossed her legs and closed her eyes. Under the light of the moonlight, she looked like a fairy from Guanghan, independent from the world and incomparable. Xuanyuan looked a little crazy.

For a moment, Xuanyuan seemed to enjoy this quiet feeling. It would be great if this moment could last forever, just watching quietly...

Yin Zhenluo opened her beautiful eyes, looked at Xuanyuan who was looking at her dreamily, pointed at the roasted suckling pig in front of her, and said:

"You can make it into dried meat. Whatever you eat, I will eat with you. There is no need to prepare it specially. Starting from tomorrow, practice begins."

Yin Zhenluo rolled her eyes at Xuanyuan angrily and funny, stood up, walked to the tree bed step by step, lay down and said:

"Rest, I'll sleep on the bed, you sleep on the floor."

Xuanyuan wiped his saliva, nodded hurriedly and said:

"That's right. It's already good that you didn't let me sleep outside!"

"Also, since you have worshiped me as your teacher, I will make a rule first." Yin Zhenluo was lying on the wooden bed, leaning sideways, with a pair of big bright eyes, as gentle as water under the moonlight, which made Xuanyuan intoxicated again.

"Starting tonight, you can attack me at any time and under any circumstances. If the attack is successful, you can do whatever you want."

When Xuanyuan heard this, his eyes flashed, his tiger body trembled, his saliva flowed, and he pounced directly towards Yin Zhenluo like a hungry wolf.

Yin Zhenluo sighed silently, flicked her jade fingers, and a ray of strong wind hit Xuanyuan's forehead directly, sending Xuanyuan flying away and rolling three or four times on the ground, making him extremely embarrassed.

Lone Star did not roar at Yin Zhenluo like before, making threatening sounds, and there seemed to be a hint of schadenfreude in his wolf eyes.

Xuanyuan was unwilling to give in. That night, Xuanyuan attacked Yin Zhenluo seventeen times. Each time, he didn't even touch Yin Zhenluo's hair, and the end was terrible.
